problem: A delayed v1 scene import used the mutable global player from the next page. Shared Player.load could build after stop/disposal during its kit import. v2 registered detach cleanup only after loading, and stale imports/errors could replace a newer view on the same host.

reproduction.boundary: Native controlled import/load promises and DOM/resource mocks; no real browser or WebGL.

implementation.v1: Increment a scene request epoch on teardown/new mount; use the owned Stage/Player and guard all async continuations, captions, progress, keys and controls. Only current errors display fallback and release resources.
implementation.sharedEngine: Player.stop invalidates pending load epochs; Player.load checks epoch/disposed/detached-canvas state before creation and after kit import, returns false when abandoned and true on success. Stage.dispose marks its disposed state.
implementation.v2: Bind to the actual .stage3d view/canvas identity. Install detach cleanup before awaiting Player.load; clean up current failures and suppress stale errors/callbacks/buttons/onDone. Old cleanup retains another live fullscreen lock owner.
implementation.scope: No geometry, scene content, lighting, camera fitting, captions, speech timing, assessment contract or report changes. Shared engine import URL remains canonical for Stage.live identity; entry and mounts cache tags were bumped. Actual release must verify fresh engine/module responses.
implementation.cacheFix: The first mounts import replacement missed its pre-existing versioned URL; the exact import was corrected and final tests use that source.

tests.fullCommand: env -u SCIENCE_PLAYWRIGHT node --test science-lab/*.test.mjs science-lab/bank/*.test.mjs science-lab/v2/*.test.mjs scripts/tests/science-3d-plan.test.mjs

preservation.browserExecutionOptOut: SCIENCE_PLAYWRIGHT explicitly removed for the final full native run.

limits: Native lifecycle correctness and exact data/HTML comparisons are not actual PC/phone/A4/WebGL/voice proof. Final mandatory node scripts/check-science-3d.mjs failure0, real delayed-navigation scenarios, v1/v2 visual consistency, preserved mainWIP reconciliation, main integration and deployment remain. Existing browser authorization restriction respected: no browser/server, API, merge, push, deploy or cleanup.
